homepage.presentation: Sigma.2000 is a young multidisciplinary artist from Nantes, originating from graffiti and evolving into digital art.

about.pratices: Each of her practices influences and interacts with the others, forming a unique style characterized by a dancing and sharp line.
about.abstraction: Her work often distorts reality, driven by a genuine maelstrom that leads her creations toward pure abstraction.
about.conclusion: Fueled by a visceral desire to capture the moment, Sigma.2000 freezes fragments of a world in constant transformation.

career.intro: Holder of a degree in art history and passionate about self-learning, I have enriched my knowledge through various evening classes at fine arts schools, particularly in drawing and oil painting.
career.beginning: For three years, I attended a life drawing class with Emmanuel Billeaud, who taught me a great deal. I began creating by exploring various mediums at Centrale 7, guided in part by Christophe Forget.
career.digital-art: I discovered digital art through numerous workshops organized by Stereolux and AADN, which allowed me to broaden my creative horizons
career.conclusion: More recently, I have also become a web developer, enabling me to combine my artistic background with the digital world.

legal.productsText: The website offers original artworks, prints, objects and artistic creations. Each product is presented with a description, a price and, where necessary, information about size, medium, materials or specific features.
legal.pricesText: Prices are displayed in euros. Any delivery fees are displayed before payment confirmation.
legal.orderProcessText: The order is confirmed when the customer accepts these terms and conditions and completes payment. An order is only final once payment has been confirmed.
legal.paymentText: Payments are securely processed by Stripe. The website does not store the customer's bank card details.
legal.customOrdersText: For certain custom orders or made-to-order creations, a deposit may be requested before production begins. The terms will be specified to the customer before confirmation.
legal.shippingText: In-stock products are prepared after payment confirmation. Shipping times are provided for information only and may vary depending on destination, carrier and product type.
legal.shippingOutside: Shipping outside the usual delivery area
legal.shippingOutsideText: For delivery outside mainland France or to an area not automatically available at checkout, the customer may contact Sigma.2000 to discuss a personalised solution.
legal.returnsText: For non-personalised products, the customer may request a return within 14 days of receipt. Products must be returned in good condition. In case of a change of mind, return shipping costs may remain at the customer's expense.
legal.withdrawalText: Under distance selling rules, consumers generally have 14 days from receipt of the goods to exercise their right of withdrawal. This right may be excluded for personalised products or products made to the customer's specifications.
legal.damagedProductText: If a product arrives damaged, the customer should contact Sigma.2000 promptly with photographs of the package and product so that a solution can be proposed.
legal.lawText: These terms are governed by French law.
legal.privacyCollectionText: The website collects data necessary for customer account creation, order processing, payment, delivery and customer service: first name, last name, email address, postal address, phone number, order information and login data.
legal.privacyUseText: Collected data is used to manage customer accounts, process orders, arrange delivery, respond to requests, provide customer support, secure the website and comply with legal obligations.
legal.privacyPaymentText: Payments are processed by Stripe. Bank card data is transmitted directly to Stripe and is not stored by the website.
legal.privacySharingText: Personal data is not sold. It may only be shared with service providers necessary to operate the service, including Stripe for payment, technical hosting providers and carriers for order delivery.
legal.privacySecurityText: Technical and organisational measures are implemented to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration or disclosure.
legal.privacyRetentionText: Data is kept for as long as necessary to manage customer relations, orders, after-sales service and legal obligations.
legal.privacyRightsText: Under GDPR and French data protection law, you may request access, rectification, deletion, restriction or objection to the processing of your personal data by writing to the contact address provided on the website.
legal.privacyConsentText: By using the website and submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read this privacy policy.
